name: Field or loss-of-excitation protection
summary: Detects an abnormal machine excitation condition using the implementation's field or electrical measurements.
description: Detects an abnormal machine excitation condition using the implementation's field or electrical measurements.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the machine measurements and excitation reference. The associated drawing should trace the excitation alarm or generator trip path; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the machine measurements and excitation reference.
Trace the excitation alarm or generator trip path.
drawingChecklist: Label the machine measurements and excitation reference.
Cross-reference the excitation alarm or generator trip path.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: Loss-of-excitation protection supervises a condition; device 41 switches the field circuit.
